'''Matt Carulli''' is listed as '''Special Projects &amp; Multimedia Advocate''' on the July 2021 Players Committee organization chart, with forum handle '''quickdraw3457''' and role contact multimedia@starwarsccg.org. That Advocate header role is '''absent''' from the May 2024 org-chart Advocate row in the snapshot cited here.<ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''Org chart 2021:''' Special Projects &amp; Multimedia Advocate; handle '''quickdraw3457'''.<ref name="orgchart2021" />
